text:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to cut release/1.12 tomorrow 18:00 PT. Need to lock down backport policy and a cherry-pick queue. Quick sign-offs?
Priya: Ack. Are we doing bugfix-only after cutoff? :thinking_face:
Alex: Yes — bugfix + docs only after cutoff. No behaviour changes or feature flags. Also: changelog entries must land under CHANGELOG/unreleased before the cut.
Jun: I have a small perf fix in PR #3421 that should go into 1.12. Low risk. Can someone approve a backport?
Maya: Assign to @Thomas for review? Thomas, can you take a look when you have a moment? :eyes:
Thomas: I can take it tonight. If it's a single-commit change we can cherry-pick. Reminder: include a test and a changelog line.
Jun: Will do. I'll open a backport PR against release/1.12 with branch name bp/3421-release-1.12 and include backport notes.
Alex: Backport procedure reminder: branch off release/1.12, cherry-pick the commit, run full unit tests + lint, and include `backport: #3421` in the PR body. Example: ```bash
# from local clone
git fetch origin
git checkout -b bp/3421-release-1.12 origin/release/1.12
git cherry-pick <sha-of-commit>
# fix conflicts if any, run tests
git push origin bp/3421-release-1.12
```
Maya: Also: infra touch policy — any backport touching runtime or kernels needs an approver from eng-runtime. cc @Thomas and @Jun to confirm.
deploy-bot: release/1.12 branch created by Alex at 1758303000 — CI will run on new branches.
Priya: Quick changelog nudge: use heading `### Bug fixes` and add one-line summary + PR link. The release script aggregates CHANGELOG/unreleased into the final notes.
Jun: Opening backport PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3540 (bp/3421-release-1.12). Tests running.
Thomas: Left a couple of tiny review comments (test name + one assert). Once fixed I'll approve and merge.
Alex: If a cherry-pick fails due to conflicts, post the conflict sha here and tag me. We'll triage merges before the cut. After cut we'll tag v1.12.0 and run the smoke suite.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll update the release checklist with the cutoff window and link this thread for backport guidance.
Maya: Adding note — any backport that changes API surface must go through product sign-off even if it's a bugfix.
Jun: Understood. This one is internal perf only. Will update tests and changelog shortly.
Thomas: Approving once CI is green.
Alex: Thanks team — keep updates here so we have an audit trail.
